title: Two concurrent runs of the same workflow -> disjoint workspaces
rule: specs/aip-58.mdx section 4 Run workspace -- "Two runs MUST NEVER share a workspace"

expected.invariant: run_A's scratch/, inputs/, and artifacts/ directories share no path with run_B's -- writing outputsFiles.brief for run_A never touches, overwrites, or is visible from run_B's workspace, even though both runs share the same workflow ref and outputsFiles.brief.path template.
notes: This is the exact failure the Motivation cites: two runs overwriting each other's files. The <runId> path-interpolation token (AIP-16) is what keeps the two concrete paths distinct even though the template is identical.
